abstract: The Advanced Media Workflow Association (AMWA) continues to develop and refine Networked Media Open Specifications (NMOS) to support reliable, interoperable workflows in both broadcast and Pro AV environments. Over the past year, AMWA has advanced work in several areas, including minimum status reporting (BCP-008), the Open Source Sender Receiver Framework (OSSRF), support for MPEG Transport Stream (BCP-006-04), and NMOS extensions for IPMX. This update highlights the challenges being addressed, the processes underway, and the progress made across these four initiatives.
